about: The Telegram voice evaluation set (doc/agentmaster/VOICE.md section 7). The owner reads each sentence as ONE Telegram voice note in a session's topic; tools/voice-poc/fetch_tg_voice.py stores it as <id>.oga under Q:\agentmaster-voice\recordings. 'terms' are the technical words whose exact spelling must survive: a term with capitals must come through with that spelling, an all-lowercase term only as the same words. Numbers and units are scored by WER only (sixteen kilohertz == 16 kHz).

sentences.text: Check why the ConPTY host in Agentmaster drops the hook events from the named pipe after a session resumes.
Decode the Telegram voice note from Ogg Opus to sixteen kilohertz mono PCM, then run Parakeet on the GPU and post the transcript back to the topic.
Add a unit test that feeds the transcript scanner a JSONL file with forty lines and asserts the session state flips from Running to Waiting.
